title: Open-weight AI companies are the Valley's hottest acquisition targets | TechCrunch
summary: Nik Albarran, the AI product lead at Jellyfish, told TechCrunch that open-weight models are primarily used by companies whose products rely on repeated inference workloads, like those providing customer service chats.
